Load balance

Power per source, storage, DC/DC conversion and consumer group, and the energy per consumer over the selected time range. **Times are UTC.** All power is shown in **W** (Grafana switches to kW where it reads better), temperatures in °C. The info icon of each panel states its source and scaling. **Scaling: current vs requested.** Values not yet published in W are scaled in the dashboard; the request to Marpower is to publish them in W. | Signal | Now on MQTT | Requested | In this dashboard | |---|---|---|---| | uGrid PS/SB `PvPower` (`…45-dc-ac/inverter/05-11-u101`, `…/05-12-u101`) | kW | W | × 1000 | | uGrid topic names | PS `45-dc-ac/inverter/05-11-u101`, SB `45-dc-ac/inverter/05-12-u101` | one pattern for both | both read | | Brightloop `PvPower` (`45-battery/pack/05-4x-y`) | kW, never negative | W, signed (charge / discharge) | × 1000, shown as is | | BMS `BatteryPower` | kW, signed | W | × 1000 | | Shore power `esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` | kW | W | × 1000 | | Shore power `esi_bms_charge_limit_ac_power` | presumably kW | W | not shown | | Shore power `esi_ac_bus_frequency`, 70.12 TBC1a | ≈ 605, where 70.11 sends 50.05 Hz | Hz, to be checked | not shown | | 350 V DCOPP `PosLinePower`, `NegLinePower` | kW (IO list); no data since 19 Oct 2026 | W, and publish | × 1000 | | Epic power and solar `hvdc_power` (`45-solar/dc-dc-converter/…`, `45-dc-350v/dc-dc-converter/…`; `busbar/epc-…` until 5 Nov 2026) | unknown, converters not running | W, to be confirmed | shown as is | | Leuze `OutputCurrent` (`45-dc-24v/breaker/14ex-yyf01`) | mA, no power | A, or W per module | ÷ 1000; power computed | **Already in order:** the 10P0.1 meters (W), the power tags (W), the Weidmuller converters (W, V, A, °C), the transformer temperatures (°C). **Notes.** - **Power tags:** the overview total counts only the main switchboard 10P0-1 and 10P0-3. Their feeders to 10P1 (135Q01) and 10P2 (335Q01) are power tags themselves, so adding 10P1 and 10P2 would count those loads twice. The energy tree map leaves those two feeders out for the same reason. The power tags of 10P3 are configured but not published: nothing arrives on MQTT, and GreptimeDB holds three empty rows (29 Sep to 11 Oct 2026). Until they publish, its feeder 336Q01 on 10P0-3 is its only measurement and is shown as the group 10P3 in the tree map. - **Leuze power** is computed in this dashboard as output current × the voltage of the Weidmuller pair that feeds it, until the dbt views that compute it are deployed. The feeding converter comes from the 24 V metadata: the 14E3 modules are fed by the emergency Weidmuller W14E2_01, so they are grouped with emergency. The 16 spare modules have no known converter and use the average voltage of their bus. - **Brightloops:** `PvPower` is shown as published, without sign; the BMS battery power is shown beside it for the direction. Packs 05_42 and 05_45 publish −500 A and no power. 05_46 sent constant values (about 27 kW) on 21 Oct 2026, which inflates the brightloop total in the overview. Which brightloop is which yard tag (aft 1–4, fwd 1–2) is not settled. - **uGrid temperatures:** `TempIgbt` and `TempPowerStage` read 199 / 198 °C while a uGrid converter is not enabled. That is a fault value, not a temperature. - **350 V DCOPP:** nothing published since 19 Oct 2026, so those panels stay empty until the modules publish again. - **Solar and Epic power** converters were not running on 21 Oct 2026; their power unit is not confirmed. Since 5 Nov 2026 06:07 UTC they publish in their own tables; each series combines the old `busbar` topic and the new table. The solar converters report `hvdc_power` negative while the panels feed the DC bus; it is shown inverted, so production is positive.

spec.title: Power per group
spec.description: Total power per group, each the sum of its topics: shore power converters (`esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` × 1000), uGrid PS and SB (`PvPower` × 1000), brightloops (`PvPower` × 1000, without sign), the Weidmuller converters of the 24 V service and emergency supply (`Power`, W), and the power tags of the main switchboard 10P0-1 and 10P0-3 (`active_power_total`, W). 10P1 and 10P2 are left out of the total, as their feeders 135Q01 and 335Q01 are power tags on 10P0.

spec.rawSql:
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT 'Shore power' AS grp, time, sum(p) AS p FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase__value) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid PS', date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01'), avg(pv_power__value) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE technical_name IN ('05-11-u101') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid SB', date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01'), avg(pv_power__value) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/45-dc-ac/inverter/05-12-u101' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Brightloops', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(pv_power__value) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__battery__pack WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN topic LIKE '%/w14e1-%' THEN '24 V service' ELSE '24 V emergency' END, time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(power__value) AS p
    FROM public.marpower__dc_24v__power_supply WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic LIKE 'marpower/45-dc-24v/power-supply/%' GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Power tags 10P0', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(active_power_total) AS p
    FROM public.power_tags WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3') GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2)
SELECT time, grp AS "Group", p AS "Power" FROM parts ORDER BY 2, 1

spec.title: Power per group
spec.description: The latest value per source within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range, combined like the trend; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message of the panel's stalest source.

spec.rawSql:
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT 'Shore power' AS grp, time, sum(p) AS p FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time, topic, last_value(esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase__value ORDER BY timestamp) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid PS', TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01', last_value(pv_power__value ORDER BY timestamp) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE technical_name IN ('05-11-u101') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid SB', TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01', last_value(pv_power__value ORDER BY timestamp) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND topic = 'marpower/45-dc-ac/inverter/05-12-u101' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Brightloops', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time, topic, last_value(pv_power__value ORDER BY timestamp) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__battery__pack WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN topic LIKE '%/w14e1-%' THEN '24 V service' ELSE '24 V emergency' END, time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time, topic, last_value(power__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS p
    FROM public.marpower__dc_24v__power_supply WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND topic LIKE 'marpower/45-dc-24v/power-supply/%' GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Power tags 10P0', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time, topic, last_value(active_power_total ORDER BY timestamp) AS p
    FROM public.power_tags WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3') GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2),
upd AS (SELECT to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(min(ts)) AS updated FROM (
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY topic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE technical_name IN ('05-11-u101') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY topic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'AND topic = 'marpower/45-dc-ac/inverter/05-12-u101' GROUP BY topic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.marpower__battery__pack WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' GROUP BY topic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.marpower__dc_24v__power_supply WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'AND topic LIKE 'marpower/45-dc-24v/power-supply/%' GROUP BY topic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT topic, max(timestamp) AS ts FROM public.power_tags WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3') GROUP BY topic
) s)
SELECT q.*, upd.updated AS "Updated" FROM (
SELECT time, grp AS "Group", p AS "Power" FROM parts ORDER BY 2, 1
) q CROSS JOIN upd
ORDER BY 2

spec.title: Shore power converters
spec.description: AC active power of the four shore power converters, `esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` × 1000 W (sent in kW). Topic `marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-1x-tbc1{a,b}`, table `marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter`.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-11-tbc1a') THEN p END) AS "70.11 TBC1a",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-11-tbc1b') THEN p END) AS "70.11 TBC1b",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-12-tbc1a') THEN p END) AS "70.12 TBC1a",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-12-tbc1b') THEN p END) AS "70.12 TBC1b"
FROM (SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase__value * 1000) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-11-tbc1a', 'marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-11-tbc1b', 'marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-12-tbc1a', 'marpower/45-dc-700v/shore-converter/07-12-tbc1b')
  GROUP BY 1, 2) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Solar converters
spec.description: `hvdc_power` of the solar converters, inverted: the converters report it negative while the panels feed the DC bus, so production shows positive; the unit is not confirmed. Source: the table `marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter` (04-31-t101, 04-32-t101, 04-32-t102) since 5 Nov 2026 06:07 UTC, before that `marpower/busbar/epc-*`; each series combines both.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  avg(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-31-t101', 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-31-t101') THEN p END) AS "04.31-T101 · Main Bimini 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-32-t101', 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t101') THEN p END) AS "04.32-T101 · Main Bimini 2",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-32-t102', 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t102') THEN p END) AS "04.32-T102 · Owners Bimini"
FROM (
  SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, -avg(hvdc_power__value) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__busbar
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-31-t101', 'marpower/busbar/epc-32-t101', 'marpower/busbar/epc-32-t102')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, -avg(hvdc_power__value) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter
  WHERE technical_name IN ('04-31-t101') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, -avg(hvdc_power__value) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter
  WHERE technical_name IN ('04-32-t101') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, -avg(hvdc_power__value) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter
  WHERE technical_name IN ('04-32-t102') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Brightloop PvPower
spec.description: `PvPower` × 1000 W (sent in kW, without sign), summed over the packs of each brightloop (05_41 … 05_46). Topic `marpower/45-battery/pack/05-4x-y`.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-battery/pack/05-41-1', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-41-2', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-41-3', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-41-4') THEN p END) AS "05_41",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-battery/pack/05-42-1', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-42-2', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-42-3') THEN p END) AS "05_42",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-battery/pack/05-43-1', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-43-2', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-43-3') THEN p END) AS "05_43",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/45-battery/pack/05-44-1', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-44-2', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-44-3', 'marpower/45-battery/pack/05-44-4') THEN p END) AS "05_44",

spec.title: Power tag energy per panel
spec.description: Energy per consumer over the selected time range, grouped by panel: per-minute average of `active_power_total` (W), summed and divided by 60, in Wh. The feeders 135Q01 (10P0-1 to 10P1) and 335Q01 (10P0-3 to 10P2) are left out, as their loads appear under 10P1 and 10P2. The power tags of 10P3 are not published, so its feeder 336Q01 (on 10P0-3) is shown as the group 10P3. Consumers without energy in the range are left out.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT group_name, item_name, sum(power) / 60 AS energy, sum(sum(power) / 60) OVER (PARTITION BY group_name) AS group_energy
FROM (SELECT date_bin('1 minute'::INTERVAL, timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, CASE WHEN component = '336Q01' THEN '10P3' ELSE panel END AS group_name,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS item_name,
    avg(active_power_total) AS power
  FROM public.power_tags
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(component, '') NOT IN ('135Q01', '335Q01')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, topic, component, consumer) m
GROUP BY group_name, item_name
HAVING sum(power) > 0
ORDER BY group_name, energy DESC

spec.title: Power tags 10P0-1
spec.description: The latest value per source within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range, combined like the trend; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the row's latest message.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT q.*, to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(q.ts_) AS "Updated" FROM (
SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS "Consumer",
  last_value(active_power_total ORDER BY timestamp) AS "Power",
  max(timestamp) AS ts_
FROM public.power_tags
WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND panel = '10P0-1' AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, topic, component, consumer
ORDER BY 2, 1
) q
ORDER BY 2
